script_text: Aries, something is shifting inside your very identity this week and you'll feel it before you understand it. Monday through Wednesday, the Sun in your 10th House trines Jupiter in Cancer while Mercury in Gemini squares Mars, making midweek communication tense—avoid signing contracts on Tuesday. The real turning point hits Thursday when Saturn enters your 1st House, demanding you take your ambitions seriously. Friday Venus sextiles your 8th House, opening doors to shared finances or deep romantic intimacy. Your career lights up as the Moon trines your 10th House Saturday—expect a compliment from authority. Best day is Thursday because Saturn energizes your drive and Venus softens your approach; worst day is Wednesday when Mars opposes your natal Mars, breeding impulsive conflict. Mars, your ruling planet, needs pause, not push—let Saturn's fresh energy in your 1st House settle before acting. Follow for daily updates.
